purpose: One citation taxonomy applied identically to the retrieval, primary post-gate and no-retrieval arms (peer review 2026-09-24 P0-1/P0-2).

headline.criterion: fabricated identifier = b1 (placeholder-pattern number, identifier under a namespace with no numeric scheme, or no NCBI record); misattributed = c (real record whose title/abstract does not name the variant's gene); non-identifiers (d) are counted separately as imprecision in every arm

no_retrieval_previous_headline.definition: variants emitting any citation (every token counted ungrounded)

retrieval_106_previous_headline.definition: 0 of 106 tokens outside the bundle (non-identifiers exempted)

provenance.lookup_source: NCBI E-utilities (esummary pubmed/clinvar; efetch pubmed abstracts)

arm_notes.retrieval_gpt4o_mini_106: gpt-4o-mini, single rater, no citation gate (pre-gate)
arm_notes.primary_pipeline_postgate: voting + verifier + citation gate; different run from the 106 run; in-bundle by construction
arm_notes.no_retrieval_E_empty_bundle: gpt-4o-mini, no evidence bundle, no gate; scored against the empty set
arm_notes.no_retrieval_R_reference_bundle: same tokens scored against the retrieval bundle of the same variant

no_retrieval_previous_headline.definition: variants emitting any citation (every token counted ungrounded)

retrieval_106_previous_headline.definition: 0 of 106 tokens outside the bundle (non-identifiers exempted)
